_JCXRxEfvCmPNlDPpUwlbA.zh: WHO於10/30公布非洲區現況之快速風險評估報告。 ○ 去年共計14國累計報告120例確定病例、17例死亡(致死率:14.2%)。由於高風險族群(如農業、採礦等人員)未接種或未完整接種疫苗、邊境流動頻繁,以及部分地區存在免疫缺口(Immunity gaps),均影響疫情傳播。該區今年截至10/12期間,有9國累計報告67例確定病例、18例死亡,近期主要集中於西非地區,包含象牙海岸今年截至9/23,累計報告30例確定病例、10例死亡(致死率:33%);布吉納法索今年截至第34週,累計報告15例確定病例、3例死亡;迦納自8/30起累計報告88例疑病例;賴比瑞亞累計1例經實驗室檢驗確定病例。 ○ 該區域雖具備重要之應變量能,包括已建立的監測系統、區域實驗室網絡、常規與反應性疫苗接種等機制。惟面臨檢體送驗延遲、資金限制,以及同時發生其他突發公衛事件。考量持續傳播可能性、跨境擴散風險、已確認之免疫缺口,以及影響疫情控制的實務運作限制,非洲區整體公共衛生風險評估為中,全球風險則維持為低。

WHO published a rapid risk assessment of the situation in the African Region on 10/30.

○ Last year, a total of 14 countries reported 120 confirmed cases and 17 deaths (case fatality rate: 14.2%). Transmission is driven by high-risk groups (such as agricultural and mining workers) who are unvaccinated or incompletely vaccinated, frequent cross-border movement, and immunity gaps in some areas. As of 10/12 this year, 9 countries in the region have cumulatively reported 67 confirmed cases and 18 deaths, mainly concentrated recently in West Africa. These include Côte d'Ivoire: as of 9/23 this year, 30 confirmed cases and 10 deaths cumulatively (case fatality rate: 33%); Burkina Faso: as of week 34 this year, 15 confirmed cases and 3 deaths cumulatively; Ghana: 88 suspected cases cumulatively reported since 8/30; Liberia: 1 laboratory-confirmed case cumulatively.

○ The region has important response capacities, including established surveillance systems, a regional laboratory network, and routine and reactive vaccination mechanisms. However, it faces delays in specimen transport, funding constraints, and concurrent other public health emergencies. Considering the continued transmission potential, cross-border spread risk, confirmed immunity gaps, and operational constraints affecting outbreak control, the overall public health risk for the African Region is assessed as moderate, while the global risk remains low.

z4Gj91ovG_ErvuhbfJMUUw.en: WHO's African Region has reported 6,929 suspected cases cumulatively through week 15 this year, mainly in the DRC, Niger and Burkina Faso, including 340 deaths. Of the reported cases, 700 were confirmed by laboratory testing to have a pathogen, including Neisseria meningitidis serogroup C (39.7%), Streptococcus pneumoniae (33.7%), N. meningitidis serogroup W (15.3%) and Haemophilus influenzae type b (5.6%), among others.

2OHXGoLwCSWJpMDx6m-A9Q.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 8 and 14 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 9 in 4 countries: 5 in Ethiopia, 2 in Sudan, and 1 each in Burkina Faso and Côte d'Ivoire. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 11 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 5 across 3 countries: 3 in Algeria, and 1 each in Chad and Somalia.

_a2LG9aPvfpGyxIexkufmQ.zh: 越南胡志明市疫情持續上升,單週新增病例數突破200例,今年截至11/22累計報告逾1,800例,其中3例死亡,當局已加強疫苗接種措施。 吉爾吉斯今年截至9月累計報告13,358例病例,疫情於6月達高峰後持續下降,目前已趨緩,病例多分布於北部及西南部州別,當局已加強疫苗接種。 非洲疫情持續,今年截至11/8累計報告23萬2,363例病例,其中21,214例確診,3,136例死亡(CFR:1.35%),以剛果民主共和國報告9.2萬餘例最為嚴峻、另有衣索比亞、蒲隆地、摩洛哥、索馬利亞、奈及利亞及布吉納法索報告1至2.8萬餘例,查德及象牙海岸報告7千至8千餘例,21國報告數十至5千例不等。

Viet Nam: In Ho Chi Minh City, the outbreak continues to rise, with weekly new cases exceeding 200. As of 22 November this year, more than 1,800 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 3 deaths, and authorities have stepped up vaccination measures.

Kyrgyzstan: As of September this year, 13,358 cases have been cumulatively reported. The outbreak peaked in June and has declined since, and is now slowing. Cases are mainly distributed in the northern and south-western regions, and authorities have stepped up vaccination.

Africa: The outbreak continues. As of 8 November this year, 232,363 cases have been cumulatively reported, including 21,214 confirmed cases and 3,136 deaths (CFR: 1.35%). The Democratic Republic of the Congo has been most severely affected, reporting more than 92,000 cases. Ethiopia, Burundi, Morocco, Somalia, Nigeria and Burkina Faso each reported between 1 and more than 28,000 cases; Chad and Côte d'Ivoire reported 7,000 to more than 8,000 cases; and 21 countries reported from several dozen to 5,000 cases.
